explanation: Fast grazing impact against side/top region of wall: body moves ~0.15 per step horizontally with 6 substeps; impulse plus positional correction fails to resolve penetration, overlap grows from -0.03 at step 18 to -0.18 at step 19 exceeding 0.15 limit. Slowing vx removes failure, implicating contact correction insufficient at high tangential/normal speed.
